messages.subject: Local names for inputs, outputs
parts:
I'm building list + detail views in shiny, and right now I'm bumping into problems of state leaking in between the data from different records.

Part of this is due to the 'asynchronous' parallel nature of shiny reactives, perhaps I'm using it wrong:

  If my record view contains both first level outputs and outputs inside renderOutputs, then the outputs are updated first, then the render output runs and the inner outputs are executed.  If this takes a long time, the 'name' of the user may be displayed long before the 'photo' (inside a render output) is updated, since that needs a round trip to the client to cause it to be updated.

Part of this is due to a js throw that I'm hitting due to a false detection of duplicate names in a nested hierarchy of renderOutputs

Part of this is due to the lack (in HTML #id and shiny names) for local names for things:

For example, if I have a database with 10 rows, and I want to select a row and display the record, the very same ui widgets and output$s are used for one record and the next.

Imagine if html id's were local and nested - I would simply need to set an id for the record view container, and the inner inputs and outputs would get local names that could not be confused with those from the previous record.

I'm not sure how nesting would work on the shiny side - perhaps nested 'server' objects.

Please help!  

-Alex
